title: Declining to discuss Ray Charles' drug problem
summary: He prefers not to talk about it; Ray never missed jobs.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: He was a side man. Well how did that, it was fairly common knowledge that he had a drug problem. How did that affect your dealings with him? I don't want to even talk about that. I don't want to talk about that. But it must have had some kind of impact. Or in general dealing with guys in any, in any, in any, in any, in any, in any, in any, in a band in general when they have, when they have drug problems.
Yeah, I'd rather not have to go into that. I might have to work with him again.

No, I'm just saying, Ray's already always talked about it already in his books, in his autobiography. He goes on for pages about it. I'm just, he's already talked about his drug problems. So anything, any comments you have isn't, isn't going to be new, really new knowledge. But just I was wondering how it would impact how you dealt with it.
Well I had to knock off the band whenever, he never did miss any jobs. He was always there. And I enjoyed playing with him, with his band.
